text: The foundry-designer interface that specifies the layer map, design-rule (DRC) deck, validated pcells with measured performance distributions, and compact models is called the process design kit, or ___.
explanation: The PDK (process design kit) is the contract between foundry and designer; its deepest clause is that only PDK components carry guaranteed performance. Every custom polygon carries the designer's own risk on a 4-9 month feedback loop.
